searchText: it seems like grandine and nimbus are the ones dragging the current gas limit down as they still default to 60M post gloas fork. it wasn't/isn't an immediate priority. probably will though yeah its not a huge prio, just noticed that we have up/down voting still on the devnet. nothing about it seems particular compelling to me but whatever likely lower fiction to implement it in long term I mean its def easier to implement than make a change in your default gas limit values and make a new release for it practically it's not though the choice is either change --gas-limit or change --network to something custom they're basically equivalent, both become nondefault until next release again, at some point, it's merged so whatever, lower friction see above. But that's not due to deep technical reasons, it's because it's the specs(tm) now and the complaints (yours or someone else's) will last until it's done it's on overcomplicated, overengineered, and essentially unnecessary addendum to the config files the 20 epoch offset is pointless etc etc but none of that matters anymore, fine its 20 epochs for the devnet its likely be a day or two for mainnet or whatever we decide and we can do stepwise gas limit change every day, to see if nothing breaks a day or two isn't enough to deploy new versions on one end and the increase is gradual regardless on the other it's "stepwise" regardless then 3 day? LOL like the time period is not of question here I mean, sort of? it needs to hit enough stake The question is how do we ensure a stable increase of gas limit change without needing to make x many releases and have thousands of node operators update their clients there's no precedent of which I'm aware of getting that number of clients on mainnet updated that quickly in a controlled/triggered way a month? ok. but then that's just usual-new-version territory so the time kind of does matter You might make a release every month but that doesn't mean that every nimbus user will update once a month? no, of course also nimbus does monthly releases, lighthouse makes a release per fork (probably more tbh, but the point holds, they do make generally less releases than other clients) so different clients will have different ideas about how often someone should release/update sure we have a PR, will wait for team to review it first Barnabas selling the EIP "this will be optional", yes it is if you don't wanna get whipped daily 😂 optional but highly recommended 😂
